plan.title: refactor(agents-md): Phase 2 Wave 3b — compress umbrella / queue / body→comments / process cards to clear ≤8192

narratives.Description: After Wave 3a, compress Umbrella / Cache triage queue / Issue body→comments / Development Process (+ Contextual guardrails if needed) in agents-entry until verify:agents-md-budget reports managed absolute ≤8192 B. Phase-2 success closer for epic #2491.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want the remaining process cards thin enough that managed AGENTS.md is at most 8192 bytes, so that Phase-2 always-on shrink can close.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) HARD GATE: merge #2501 (plan id 2501-wave3a-discovery-eviction) first — rebase onto master after it lands. 2) Compress Umbrella status, Cache-as-authoritative, Issue body→comments, and Development Process sections in content/templates/agents-entry.md to !/⊗ + commands.md / skill pointers; trim Contextual guardrails only if still over 8192. 3) Update packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills/agents_entry_contract.test.ts; task agents:refresh; re-seed absoluteMaxBytes to ≤8192 (or measured size ≤8192). 4) CHANGELOG.md Closes #2502 Refs #2491; update #2491 current-shape. Verify: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills/agents_entry_contract.test.ts; task verify:agents-md-budget; task check --allow-over-cap. Success: managed absolute ≤8192 B.

narrative.Acceptance: Given agents-entry after #2501, when umbrella/queue/body→comments/process cards are read, then they are pointer-thin without losing !/⊗ obligations.
Given the compress, when verify:agents-md-budget runs, then managed absolute bytes are ≤8192.
Given edits, when contract tests and agents:refresh run, then they pass and absoluteMaxBytes is re-seeded.
Given merge, when PR lands, then CHANGELOG cites Closes #2502 and #2491 current-shape notes Phase-2 managed bar met.
